projects.description: A website for Legion, a made-up health company. It has six pages: home, platform, AI care agent, contact, sign in and create account.

projects.name: Pixel Verse Studios
projects.description: Pixel Verse Studios makes educational games and has a marketing website for them. Crab Quest: an ocean adventure that follows a crab through 6 chapters. Space X: an educational space shooter that teaches a fact about the solar system each time the game ends.

projects.description: A health-tech platform that closes the gap between "I don't feel well" and "I know what to do". A 24-hour chatbot gives a first read on symptoms, and the site lists doctors and hospitals (with prices and booking) and a library of diseases.
